component.name: XTA
component.summary: A private, read-oriented way to browse X

description.p: XTA reads X and other sources, such as Bluesky, Mastodon, Reddit, Substack and RSS feeds, and never posts, likes or shares anything in your name. The accounts you follow, your groups, saved posts and likes stay on this computer.

ul.li: Timelines of the accounts you follow, in groups you arrange
Saved posts with notes, offline articles and downloads
No trackers: XTA talks only to the sites you read
